title: prefill/decode: stage-overlap + chunked speculative prefill + kernel scheduler + KV cache warmup
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Reduce end-to-end per-request latency and increase GPU utilization for mixed prefill+decode workloads by overlapping prefill and decode stages, enabling chunked speculative prefill, and improving kernel scheduling + KV-cache warmup heuristics. This PR combines a set of complementary changes: (1) allow prefill to emit chunked KV updates earlier to unblock downstream decode, (2) speculative prefill for likely-following tokens so decode can start earlier for long-context generations, (3) stage-overlap orchestration that allows token-level overlap between prefill and decode pipelines, (4) a small kernel-scheduler change that prioritizes short-latency decode kernels while keeping long prefill kernels batched, and (5) KV cache warmup heuristics to reduce first-decode stall on cold caches. Key outcomes in our internal bench: - P50 latency for 4k-context completion (prefill + decode) improved by ~27% (380ms -> 278ms) on A100 dense workloads. - Token throughput for batched decode-heavy workloads improved by ~15% at 95th percentile utilization. - End-to-end tail improved by ~18% with negligible quality regressions on our eval prompts. Changeset summary (single-line per commit): commit: split-prefill-chunks-emit-early: move chunked prefill emission logic into PrefillEmitter; commit: speculative-prefill-policy: add heuristic policy and config knobs; commit: stage-overlap-orchestrator: orchestrator for inter-stage handoff and backpressure; commit: kernel-scheduler-priorities: add priority lanes + short-kernel fast-path; commit: kv-warmup-heuristics: wake-up + lightweight warmup on idle GPUs. Checklist:
- [x] Design doc: internal doc/notes linked in Linear ENG-4321
- [x] Unit tests for PrefillEmitter and orchestrator
- [x] Integration tests in perf-canary
- [x] Benchmarks and perf numbers in PR description
- [x] Feature-flag guarded (default off for now in release channel)

References: earlier incremental PRs with prefills/overlap: pr-87111, pr-89901; internal design ticket Linear ENG-4321. Rollout plan: behind feature flag 'prefill_stage_overlap_v2' under RuntimeConfig; staged canary -> dedicated -> general release. CI notes: flaky kernel microbench retriggered twice and subsequently passed; full perf-canary and nightly bench runs included in check run artifacts.

reviews: Diego Morales (reviewer): Looks great overall. A few questions on backpressure corner cases when decode falls behind prefill; suggest adding a small token-budget cap to the speculative policy. Requested changes.
Asha Patel (author): Added token_budget cap and conservative default; updated tests to cover decode-behind-prefill scenario (see integration test).
Luc Chen (reviewer): Kernel scheduler change LGTM but please add a short microbenchmark to show prioritization improves decode P50 without hurting batch throughput. Approved after microbench added.
